LOOK: Special Assistant to the President Antonio Lagdameo Jr. and DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian distribute additional relief goods in Capiz province on Thursday, October 23.

They assured that the Marcos administration is extending aid to the victims of the massive flooding that occurred on October 18–19.

They were joined by former Senator Mar Roxas, Special Assistant to the President Lorenzo Sagucio Jr., Capiz 1st District Rep. Howard Guintu, Vice Gov. Jaime Magbanua, Roxas City Mayor Ronnie Dadivas, and Panay Mayor Sonny Besa.
